title: Tight Hedge regret bound
statement:
Fix $N \ge 1$ experts and a horizon of $T$ rounds, and run the Hedge algorithm with a learning rate $\eta > 0$. For every valid loss sequence $\ell$ — one whose losses satisfy $0 \le \ell_t(i) \le 1$ for all rounds $t$ and experts $i$ — the regret of Hedge is bounded by
\[
  R_T(\eta) \;\le\; \frac{\log N}{\eta} + \frac{\eta\,T}{8}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: valid loss sequence: all losses in [0,1]
replaced:
\textbf{Tight Hedge Regret Bound} (Cesa-Bianchi \& Lugosi).
For any valid loss sequence with $N$ experts, $T$ rounds, and $\eta > 0$,
\[
  R_T(\eta) \;\le\; \frac{\ln N}{\eta} + \frac{\eta T}{8}.
\]
